name: cavemio-live-activity
title: Live activity
description: One pill for whatever is happening now: it updates in place, tap it and it grows into a panel, done blurs into a check.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The pill is a button with aria-expanded controlling the panel, a labelled group; Escape returns focus to the pill.
- A polite status region announces the label and when it’s done or failed, never the progress or the rolling figure.
- The spinner only spins while an activity runs; green and red always come with a check or an alert and words.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion the pill changes size and content in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: activity
props.description: – · { id, label, status?, progress?, count?, icon?, title?, detail?, steps?, actions? }; null folds the pill away.

props.name: expanded / defaultExpanded / onExpandedChange
props.description: – · Whether the panel is open; controlled or not.

useCases.title: Uploads, imports and exports

useCases.title: Deploys and builds

useCases.title: Syncs and backups

features.title: One pill for the work in progress
features.description: It opens from nothing when work starts and folds away when you set the activity to null.

features.title: It updates in place
features.description: The label morphs, the ring eases to the new progress and the figure rolls.

features.title: A new activity replaces the old
features.description: The new face rises in out of a blur while the pill reshapes to fit its label.

features.title: Tap for the details
features.description: The pill itself grows into a panel with a title, a progress bar, steps that tick off and actions.

features.title: Done is visible
features.description: The spinner blurs into a drawn check, or an alert on failure, and the bar turns emerald or red.

features.title: Quiet for screen readers
features.description: A polite status announces the label and when it is done or failed, never the progress figure.

states.title: arrive / leave
states.description: Setting an activity opens the pill from nothing (width, opacity, scale 0.85→1, 480ms); setting null folds it away, keeping its last content while it goes.

states.title: update
states.description: Same id: the label morphs, the 16px ring eases to the new progress (500ms) and count rolls.

states.title: switch
states.description: A new id: the pill’s face rises in out of a 5px blur (360ms) while its width eases to the new label.

states.title: expand
states.description: Tap: width, height and corners ease from the pill to the panel (480ms) while the pill’s face blurs out and the panel’s fades in after it. Escape (focus returns to the pill) or a tap outside folds it back.

states.title: done / error
states.description: The spinner blurs into a check that draws itself (420ms), or an alert; the bar turns emerald or red; steps tick as they finish.
